dataset_runner_role_sql.fixture_fix: New probe is explicitly localhost:54322 only and uses the existing transactional postgres -> non-inheriting/set-only Dataset-runner membership pattern inside its savepoint. Each case rolls it back. No hosted retry/permission change or runtime change.

failures_preserved: Initial generated SQL had a replacement-string syntax error; corrected before acceptance.
Large fixture exposed the existing generic source-fixture byte budget; changed only the synthetic fixture to use actual Google packaging and bounded synthetic native pages.
Multipart product projection incorrectly used the first package as primary source for every row; corrected to the physical source page batch.
Verified empty day exposed a fingerprint precondition requiring at least one row; Google-only fingerprint now accepts zero and still requires exact physical count.

501-row SQL fixture hit the unchanged 30-second statement timeout on a run; Google-private canonical/retention preparation now reuses the already established stable patterns. Timeout was not increased.
A full local suite started before code freeze is not acceptance evidence; its snapshot guards detected subsequent edits. A frozen final run is required.

limitations: This is functional synthetic validation, not a timing or capacity result.
The 501-row SQL case contains 250 product performance rows, 250 product sale rows and one entity-performance row; it is not 501 orders or 501 stores.
Standard role/profile and full replay acceptance remain dependent on required CI.
